'''''Glossopappus''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the [[Asteraceae|daisy family]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/41771#page/751/mode/1up Kunze, Gustav. 1846.  Flora 29: 748-749] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40015200 Tropicos, ''Glossopappus'' Kunze ]</ref>

;Species<ref name=v/><ref>[http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/search?q=Glossopappus The Plant List, search for ''Glossopappus'']</ref>
There is only one known species, '''''Glossopappus macrotus''''', native to the western [[Mediterranean]] ([[Algeria]], [[Morocco]], [[Tunisia]], [[Spain]], [[Portugal]])
